people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

translations.web: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”
translations.bsb: So on that day Gideon was called Jerubbaal, that is to say, “Let Baal contend with him,” because he had torn down Baal’s altar.
translations.kjv: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
translations.asv: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal contend against him, because he hath broken down his altar.
